        (SELECT ml.msg_log_data
           FROM sl_msg_log ml
          WHERE ml.evt_data_seq = ed.evt_data_seq
            AND ml.msg_log_data LIKE 'Failed to send%'
            AND ml.msg_log_seq = (SELECT MAX(ml2.msg_log_seq)
                                    FROM sl_msg_log ml2
                                   WHERE ml2.evt_data_seq = ed.evt_data_seq
                                     AND ml2.msg_log_data LIKE 'Failed to send%')) AS error_message
   FROM sl_evt_data ed
   JOIN sl_evt_arg_data ad
     ON ad.evt_data_seq = ed.evt_data_seq
    AND ad.evt_arg_id = 'ORDNUM'
   LEFT
   JOIN sl_evt_arg_data ol
     ON ol.evt_data_seq = ed.evt_data_seq
    AND ol.evt_arg_id = 'ORDLIN'
   LEFT
   JOIN sl_evt_arg_data os
     ON os.evt_data_seq = ed.evt_data_seq
    AND os.evt_arg_id = 'ORDSLN'
   JOIN pckwrk_view pw
     ON pw.ordnum = ad.evt_arg_val
    AND pw.ordlin = ol.evt_arg_val
    AND pw.ordsln = os.evt_arg_val
  WHERE pw.wh_id = @wh_id
    AND pw.pcksts = 'R' 
    AND ed.ins_dt > SYSDATE - 1
    AND ed.evt_id = 'UC_PICK_REQUEST'
    AND ed.evt_stat_cd = 'SE'
    AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1
                     FROM sl_evt_data ed2
                     JOIN sl_evt_arg_data ad2
                       ON ad2.evt_data_seq = ed2.evt_data_seq
                      AND ad2.evt_arg_id = 'ORDNUM'
                     JOIN sl_evt_arg_data ol2
                       ON ol2.evt_data_seq = ed2.evt_data_seq
                      AND ol2.evt_arg_id = 'ORDLIN'
                     JOIN sl_evt_arg_data os2
                       ON os2.evt_data_seq = ed2.evt_data_seq
                      AND os2.evt_arg_id = 'ORDSLN'
                    WHERE ed2.evt_id = 'UC_PICK_REQUEST'
                      AND ed2.evt_stat_cd = 'SC'
                      AND ed2.ins_dt > ed.ins_dt
                      AND ad2.evt_arg_val = ad.evt_arg_val
                      AND ol2.evt_arg_val = ol.evt_arg_val
                      AND os2.evt_arg_val = os.evt_arg_val)] 
|
[update pckwrk_dtl 		
     set pm_err_desc = @error_message,
          pcksts = 'E'
     where wh_id = @wh_id

};

          and wes.req_type in (/*#nobind*/'GM_REPLEN'/*#bind*/, /*#nobind*/'BY_REPLEN'/*#bind*/, /*#nobind*/'BY_PUT'/*#bind*/)] catch(-1403)

{
    publish data
     where msg = 'no pending manifest left to close'
       and date = sysdate
}
else
{
    publish data
     where wh_id = @wh_id
       and carcod = @carcod
       and year = @year
       and day = @day
       and month = @month
       and full_mancls = @year || @month || @day || '/' || @carcod || '/' || @wh_id
    |
    [select distinct ordnum
       from manfst m
      where m.wh_id = @wh_id
        and m.carcod = @carcod
        and m.mansts = 'R'
        AND m.mancls = @full_mancls]
    |
    publish data
     where ordnum = @ordnum
       and wh_id = @wh_id
    |
    [WITH OrderTotals AS (
                          -- Calculate the total quantity required for the whole order once
                          SELECT ordnum, wh_id, SUM(ordqty) as total_ordqty FROM ord_line
                           WHERE ordnum = @ordnum
                             AND wh_id = @wh_id
                             AND cancelled_flg = 0
                             AND non_alc_flg = 0
                           GROUP BY ordnum,
                                 wh_id),
            PickTotals AS (
                           -- Calculate total units actually picked/on loads
                           SELECT ordnum, wh_id, SUM(untqty) as total_pckqty FROM inventory_pckwrk_view
                            WHERE ordnum = @ordnum
                              AND wh_id = @wh_id
                            GROUP BY ordnum,
                                  wh_id),
            ManifestTotals AS (SELECT ordnum,
                                      wh_id,
                                      count(lodnum) as man_lodnum
                                 FROM manfst
                                WHERE ordnum = @ordnum
                                  AND wh_id = @wh_id
                                GROUP BY ordnum,
                                      wh_id)
     SELECT ol.wh_id,
            ol.ordnum,
            sl.ship_id,
            ot.total_ordqty,
            COALESCE(pt.total_pckqty, 0) as total_pckqty,
            (ot.total_ordqty) - (pt.total_pckqty) as total_pending,
            COUNT(distinct iv.lodnum) as lodnum_cnt,
            mt.man_lodnum,
            COUNT(dtl.wrkref) as cntwrk_ref
       FROM ord_line ol
       JOIN OrderTotals ot
         ON ol.ordnum = ot.ordnum
        AND ol.wh_id = ot.wh_id
       LEFT
       JOIN PickTotals pt
         ON ol.ordnum = pt.ordnum
        AND ol.wh_id = pt.wh_id
       LEFT
       JOIN ManifestTotals mt
         ON ol.ordnum = mt.ordnum
        AND ol.wh_id = mt.wh_id
       LEFT
       JOIN shipment_line sl
         ON ol.ordnum = sl.ordnum
        AND ol.ordlin = sl.ordlin
        AND ol.wh_id = sl.wh_id
       LEFT
       JOIN pckwrk_dtl dtl
         ON sl.ship_line_id = dtl.ship_line_id
        AND sl.wh_id = dtl.wh_id
       LEFT
       JOIN inventory_pckwrk_view iv
         ON dtl.wrkref = iv.wrkref
        AND dtl.wh_id = iv.wh_id
      WHERE
     --ol.ordnum = '5667143'
     ol.wh_id = @wh_id
        AND ol.cancelled_flg = 0
        AND ol.non_alc_flg = 0
      GROUP BY ol.wh_id,
            ol.ordnum,
            sl.ship_id,
            ot.total_ordqty,
            mt.man_lodnum,
            pt.total_pckqty
     having (ot.total_ordqty) - (pt.total_pckqty) = 0
        and COUNT(distinct iv.lodnum) - (mt.man_lodnum) = 0] catch(@?)
    |
    if (@? = -1403)
    {
        publish data
         where msg = 'unable to close, pending work'
           and date = sysdate
    }
    else
    {
        publish data
         where ordnum = @ordnum
           and wh_id = @wh_id
        |
        [select *
           from manfst
          where ordnum = @ordnum
            and wh_id = @wh_id
            and mansts = 'R']
        |
        change record
         where table_name = 'MANFST'
           and crtnid = @crtnid
           and wh_id = @wh_id
           and ship_id = @ship_id
           and client_id = @client_id
           and subnum = @subnum
           and ordnum = @ordnum
           and mansts = 'S'
           and mstdte = sysdate
    }
}
